gas_headers: CO2 concentration / CO concentration (Chinese or English raw header variants)
gas_unit_status: ambiguous in problem statement; channel names say concentration; vol% is plausible but requires plant metadata confirmation
interpretation: The m3/s interpretation fails a conditional oxygen-stoichiometry feasibility check if gas channels share the O2 volume reference basis.
CO2/(CO+CO2) is an apparent CO2 share, not a complete post-combustion ratio when H2 and H2O are unavailable.
CO+CO2 channel sum is not total carbon emission unless total off-gas flow is known.
